Privacy & your data

Clear information and control.

Paid, but Complete is locked?

  1. Sign in to the Lane account you used for the purchase.
  2. Check that your device uses the App Store or Google Play account that made the purchase.
  3. Connect to the internet. Open Your account → Plan & billing and use the restore or refresh-access action.
  4. Still locked? Send us the platform, approximate purchase date and store order reference. Do not send a full receipt containing unrelated personal or financial details.

Please contact us before buying again. Purchase access may need to refresh, and paying twice is not the solution.

How do I ask for a refund?

Start with the store that processed the purchase: Apple refund help or Google Play refund help. The store and applicable law determine eligibility. Account deletion does not automatically request a refund.

My verification email hasn’t arrived.

Check spam or junk, make sure the address is correct, and wait for the resend timer. Request a new code if needed. Use only the most recent code. Never send verification codes to support.

Can I move between iPhone and Android?

Use the same Lane account to access available synced history. Purchase recognition also depends on the original store identity and supported entitlement behaviour. Cross-platform purchase transfer is not promised; contact support before buying again.

I no longer have the app installed.

You can use the account-deletion page without reinstalling Lane. Other account or privacy questions can be sent using the contact form.

Something in a question looks wrong?

Send the question ID, topic, wording that concerns you, and any relevant official source. The in-app report action is also available. We review reports before making content changes.

A HUMAN ON THE OTHER END

Let’s get it sorted.

Tell us what happened. Include useful details, but never your password, verification code or full card information.

For a question report, include its question ID when available. Up to 4,000 characters.

We use your email and message to respond to this request, as explained in our Privacy policy. This does not subscribe you to marketing.
